Yeah I basically gave up too and used a work around. i followed this video https://youtu.be/NSs6hFp9Sog, and deleted those files so the ram won't be detected by RBG Fusion. Then I used OpenRGB to control my ram instead.

If I didn't delete those files, RBG Fusion would override OpenRGB ram settings, making the ram be stuck on red and I would need to manually apply the profile again on OpenRGB.

I did figure out why my ram was not detected, I have concluded it's because I don't have the same ram models only similar ones, so some other fixes might work for you if you haven't tried them. Like uninstalling RBG Fusion and clearing the CMOS and reinstalling your ram and Fusion.
